# Project Context (ContextKit)

Version: 2.0.0

This project uses [ContextKit](https://github.com/nolrm/contextkit). The files below are its AI context.

## Always

- Read `.contextkit/standards/index.md` first — project rules and where to find more.
- If `.contextkit/goals/` has a goal file with `status: active`, read it before starting work.
- Before repeating a known mistake, check `.contextkit/corrections.md`.

## Skills

`ck` (status · setup · update · tidy) · `doc` · `learn` · `goal` · `headline` — run as `/name` in Claude Code and Cursor, `$name` in Codex.

## Working on ContextKit Itself

This repo IS the ContextKit package, not a project that installed it. `.contextkit/` and `.claude/` here are gitignored local copies — `ck install`/`ck update` regenerates them from real source. Edits inside them don't commit and never ship.

Edit the real source instead:
- Command workflow content → `commands/[path]`
- Skill names, descriptions, and frontmatter → `lib/skills/registry.js` (rendered for every tool by `lib/skills/render.js`); removed skills and their replacements → `lib/skills/retired.js`
- Bridge text (the `AGENTS.md` body, the `CLAUDE.md` import block) → `lib/integrations/agents-md.js` and `lib/integrations/*.js`
- Shipped skeletons and config template → `lib/commands/install.js`, `lib/utils/standards-index.js`, `lib/utils/config-schema.js`
- Claude Code plugin → run `npm run build:plugin` after changing `commands/` or the registry (CI fails on drift)

`.codex/skills/` is tracked here as generated output — regenerate it with the integration, don't hand-edit. After editing source, run `ck update --force` locally if you need `.contextkit/`/`.claude/` refreshed for testing.
